IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ImpactFeedback_Toolti: Enable all messages, custom animations, and sound effects. While enabled, the three individual feedback options remain active and locked.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_DynamicMessages_Toolt: Show every overhead notification and contextual dialogue generated by the mod.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_CustomAnimations_Tool: Enable custom player and zombie animations. Disabling this may improve performance.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_SoundEffects_Tooltip: Enable effort voices, door impact sounds, and every other sound forced by the mod.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ImpactTargetOutline_T: Highlight zombies in the predicted impact area with the vanilla outline. This option is independent of Melee Target Outline and is disabled by default.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ImpactTargetOutlineCo: Choose the outline color used for vanilla zombies in the predicted door-impact area.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_IncrementMessageColor: Choose the color used by stat-increase messages marked with an arrow.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_LimitationMessageColo: Choose the color used when an action is blocked by a crowd, strain, or tiredness.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_StandardMessageColor_: Choose the color used by standard contextual dialogue.
